Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

sup:70740.subject: Price basis and AS-14404 clause for round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm - our proposal
sup:70740.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation and for your letter of 22 September proposing to agree the price basis together with a price adjustment clause based on AS-14404. We agree that the two belong together, so we would like to propose one complete package:

- Unit price: EUR 4.60/kg
- Payment: 30 days net
- Contract term: 36 months
- Price adjustment: AS-14404, material share 45%, 0% deadband, base month 2026-08

The enquiry terms stay as stated: 23,700 kg per year, DAP, 14-day lead time, prices valid from 1 January 2027, no tooling.

With this clause, alloy movements on the material share are passed through transparently in both directions. The base price can then reflect the agreed basis rather than a forecast of alloy prices. In return, we offer planning security. Our authorised requirement of 23,700 kg per year would be committed for three years instead of one. This is not additional volume, exclusivity or a monthly call-off schedule. It is a stable, committed account for the full term, which we understand matters to you as you focus on customers with volume.

On the price level: our orders with you on 2 and 17 June 2026 were at EUR 5.26/kg (po:4500014022-10, po:4500014078-10). Our orders on 1 and 18 September 2026 were at EUR 5.84/kg (po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10). Your quotation of EUR 6.10/kg, without any clause, would add a further step on top of that. We would prefer to reset the basis on a transparent footing that works for both sides over three years.

Could you let me know whether this package works for you? If not, which element would you need adjusted?

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70740.subject: Re: Price basis and AS-14404 clause for round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm - our proposal
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed the historical order prices you cited; however, current operational costs require a sustainable baseline. 

We welcome your proposal for a 36-month contract and agree to implement the AS-14404 price adjustment clause to provide mutual planning security. Therefore, we can offer a revised unit price of EUR 5.40 per kg for this three-year package. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. For this package, we can present a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

sup:70740.subject: Part 370010 – revised complete package for 2027 to 2029
sup:70740.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised quotation, and for welcoming the 36-month term together with the AS-14404 price adjustment clause. That gives us a solid common structure. We would now like to close the remaining gap on the price basis.

We propose one complete package:

- Unit price: EUR 5.00/kg
- Payment: 30 days net
- Contract term: 36 months
- Price adjustment: AS-14404, material share 45%, 5% deadband, base month 2026-08

We are moving from EUR 4.60 to EUR 5.00/kg. We are also keeping our authorised 23,700 kg per year committed for three full years.

The 5% deadband is part of this proposed exchange and has not already been agreed. Small alloy movements would not trigger an adjustment, which keeps administration simple for both sides. Larger movements would still pass through transparently in both directions.

On costs, we recognise that your cost drivers rose over the past twelve months. The most recent movement points the other way: PPI-C2431, which you cite as 38% of your cost, changed by -2.27% from June to August 2026 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08). Together with the clause on the material share, we see EUR 5.00/kg as a sustainable basis for a stable three-year account.

The enquiry terms remain unchanged: 23,700 kg per year, DAP, 14-day lead time, prices valid from 1 January 2027, and no tooling. The commitment involves no additional volume, exclusivity or monthly call-off schedule.

If this works for you, could you issue this complete package as your standing quotation? If one element does not work, please tell me which one and why, so we can look at it together.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70740.subject: Re: Part 370010 – revised complete package for 2027 to 2029
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Furthermore, we have verified the recent decrease in PPI-C2431 and have factored this development into our calculation. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Specifically, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Additionally, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.

We appreciate your move to EUR 5.00/kg; however, a sustainable baseline for a 36-month commitment requires a further adjustment. To close the remaining gap, we propose a revised unit price of EUR 5.20/kg under the agreed terms.

Our current offer is a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

sup:70740.subject: Part 370010 – complete package for your binding quotation
sup:70740.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised quotation, and for taking the 5% deadband into the structure. We now share the full framework: 36 months, 30 days net, and AS-14404 on a 45% material share with a 5% deadband and base month 2026-08. The only open point is the starting price.

We propose one complete package:

- Unit price: EUR 5.04/kg
- Payment: 30 days net
- Contract term: 36 months
- Price adjustment: AS-14404, material share 45%, 5% deadband, base month 2026-08

We are moving from EUR 5.00 to EUR 5.04/kg. Our authorised 23,700 kg per year stays committed for the full three years.

On the alloy side, AS-14404 changed by -5.49% from June to September 2026 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). We fully recognise that this recent movement sits alongside the annual increase you describe. Under the clause, alloy movements beyond the deadband will continue to adjust the price in both directions over the term. The starting price therefore does not need to carry a forecast of where alloy goes next.

The enquiry terms remain unchanged: 23,700 kg per year, DAP, 14-day lead time, prices valid from 1 January 2027, and no tooling. The commitment involves no additional volume, exclusivity or monthly call-off schedule.

Could you issue this complete package as your binding quotation? If something still stands in the way, please tell me exactly what. I would like to close this with you on a basis that works for both sides over the next three years.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70740.subject: Re: Part 370010 – complete package for your binding quotation
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with us. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have verified the recent decrease in AS-14404 from June to September 2026 and factored it into our calculation.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.

To close the remaining gap, we propose a revised unit price of EUR 5.10/kg under the agreed terms. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Here is our Angebot: a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
